business_objective: Review government-record disposal batches and clear them for disposal after retention, preservation-hold, and authorization checks.

stakeholder_statements.text: A department records clerk submits a disposal-clearance request and identifies the record series and disposal batch.
The retention officer records whether the retention requirement has been satisfied.
The legal hold reviewer records whether a preservation hold blocks disposal.
The records supervisor records the request as authorized or declined and adds a reason when it is declined.

The disposal records clerk marks the batch cleared for disposal only after retention satisfaction, no blocking preservation hold, and authorization are recorded. Physically destroying records and changing retention rules are outside this project.

business_objective: Track used-cooking-oil collection containers and close each handover record after readiness, leakage, and pickup checks are completed.

stakeholder_statements.text: The kitchen steward creates a used-oil collection record and identifies the collection container and service period.
The shift supervisor records the container as ready or not ready for collection.
The safety checker records whether visible leakage is present.
The collection driver acknowledges pickup and records the container condition at pickup.

The environmental records clerk closes the collection record only after ready status, no visible leakage, and pickup acknowledgement are recorded. Processing the used oil and transporting it after pickup are outside this project.

business_objective: Review employee leave-balance carryover requests and apply eligible, supported carryovers to the target period.

stakeholder_statements.text: An employee submits a leave-balance carryover request and identifies the leave type, requested carryover amount, and target period.
The leave records clerk records whether the available balance supports the requested carryover amount and records supporting evidence. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.
The HR policy reviewer records the request as eligible or ineligible. The eligibility criteria are undecided.
The line manager records the coverage impact as supported or unsupported. The coverage-assessment criteria are not finalized.

The workforce records officer applies the carryover only after sufficient balance, policy eligibility, and manager support are recorded, then sends the outcome to the employee. The delivery channel is undecided. Approving future leave and changing payroll calculations are outside this project.

business_objective: Review volunteer conflict disclosures and confirm assignments only when the disclosed conflict does not block participation and mitigation is acceptable.

stakeholder_statements.text: A volunteer submits an assignment-conflict disclosure and identifies the assignment, related party, nature of the relationship, and proposed mitigation.
The volunteer coordinator records the assignment as active or inactive.
The ethics reviewer records a conflict category and records the conflict as blocking or non-blocking. The conflict categories and classification criteria have not been agreed.
The program lead records the proposed mitigation as acceptable or unacceptable. The mitigation-assessment criteria are undecided.

The assignment records clerk confirms the assignment only after active assignment status, a non-blocking conflict outcome, and acceptable mitigation are recorded, then sends the outcome to the volunteer. The delivery channel is undecided. Investigating misconduct and changing volunteer-program policy are outside this project.

business_objective: Review proposed public release of research outputs while preserving an unresolved conflict between journal embargo and funder-release obligations.

stakeholder_statements.text: A study researcher submits a public-release review and identifies the study, research output, and proposed release version.
The journal liaison records the publication status and embargo status. The liaison says the output must not be publicly released until the journal embargo ends.
The funder compliance reviewer records the funding obligation. The reviewer says an accepted funded output should be released immediately even when a journal embargo remains.
The intellectual property reviewer records the output as sensitive or not sensitive and records any release restrictions. The sensitivity criteria have not been agreed.

The research governance chair records the review as approved or declined after the publication status, embargo status, funding obligation, and intellectual-property review are present. Nobody has decided which release rule controls, who resolves the disagreement, which output categories qualify for review, what evidence proves journal acceptance, or the maximum review time. Publishing the output and submitting it to a journal are outside this project; the meeting also drifted into complaints about the projector remote.
